WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-73.784258 42.895102, -73.78413 42.89402, -73.782758 42.894089, -73.78258 42.894108, -73.782528 42.894134, -73.782505 42.894169, -73.782489 42.894238, -73.782645 42.895252, -73.782676 42.89528, -73.782742 42.895287, -73.784175 42.895175, -73.784238 42.89515, -73.784258 42.895102))', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-110.042392 46.635993, -110.04207 46.635493, -110.040953 46.634248, -110.039704 46.632867, -110.038858 46.631887, -110.038224 46.63119, -110.037486 46.630647, -110.036811 46.630299, -110.035619 46.629911, -110.033639 46.629108, -110.03291 46.628739, -110.032674 46.628459, -110.030802 46.627391, -110.030437 46.62715, -110.029648 46.626814, -110.028817 46.626431, -110.02851 46.626243, -110.028226 46.62597, -110.027036 46.6245, -110.025928 46.62343, -110.025215 46.622684, -110.024663 46.622248, -110.023648 46.621316, -110.02191 46.619697, -110.02059 46.618464, -110.019853 46.617884, -110.019584 46.617699, -110.019298 46.617519, -110.019008 46.617305, -110.018082 46.616307, -110.017829 46.615993)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'National Grid parking lot' ELSE 'Middle Fork Road' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

WITH route_geoms AS (
  SELECT 
    '[3]' AS entity_id,
    ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-73.784258 42.895102, -73.78413 42.89402, -73.782758 42.894089, -73.78258 42.894108, -73.782528 42.894134, -73.782505 42.894169, -73.782489 42.894238, -73.782645 42.895252, -73.782676 42.89528, -73.782742 42.895287, -73.784175 42.895175, -73.784238 42.89515, -73.784258 42.895102))', 4326)::geometry AS geom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '[4]' AS entity_id,
    r.geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM roads
  WHERE road_name ILIKE '%Middle Fork Road%'
    AND ST_GeometryType(r.geometry) = 'ST_LineString'
    AND ST_IsValid(r.geometry)
  LIMIT 1
),
slope_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    r.entity_id,
    r.display_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ST_Slope(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.geom, TRUE), 1)) * 100, 2) AS avg_slope_percent
  FROM route_geoms r
  JOIN public.dem_us d ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Union(d.rast) AS rast
    FROM public.dem_us
    WHERE ST_Intersects(r.geom, d.rast)
  ) AS sub
  GROUP BY r.entity_id, r.display_name
)
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN s1.avg_slope_percent > s2.avg_slope_percent THEN s1.display_name
    WHEN s2.avg_slope_percent > s1.avg_slope_percent THEN s2.display_name
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS higher_slope_route,
  s1.display_name AS route1,
  s1.avg_slope_percent AS slope1,
  s2.display_name AS route2,
  s2.avg_slope_percent AS slope2
FROM slope_analysis s1
JOIN slope_analysis s2 ON s1.entity_id != s2.entity_id;
